cassettes.title: CLOUDBERRY
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: Late summer on the fells. Run and jump across bog, birch wood and stones for cloudberries, to the hut at the end.
cassettes.controls:
A D: run
LEFT RIGHT: or run
SPACE: jump, hold for higher; start

cassettes.title: DEBUG
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: Bugs march down the screen in formation. You're the cursor. Fix them.
cassettes.controls:
A D: move
LEFT RIGHT: or move
SPACE: fire (hold for more), start

cassettes.title: FELLRIDER
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: A moped over the fells, as far as it will go. Pick up the coins and the gas cans.
cassettes.controls:
W A S D: D gas, A brake, W lean back, S lean forward
UP LEFT DOWN RIGHT: the same
SPACE: start

cassettes.title: MUSIC TRACKER
cassettes.author: R.
cassettes.about: A three-voice tracker for the AUNT, the UNC's sound chip, with four tunes on the tape. Press RETURN. Then stop it and write your own.
cassettes.controls:
RETURN: play
SPACE: stop
T: next tune
Z-M: piano, stopped
I: instruments
?: all the keys
cassettes.instructions: Four tunes are on the tape: press RETURN. Then stop it, write your own, and save it to tape with the deck's Rec.

cassettes.title: ORBIT
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: Shoot the drifting rocks: a big one splits in two, a small one is gone.
cassettes.controls:
W A D: A D turn, W thrust
UP LEFT RIGHT: the same
SPACE: fire (hold for more), start

cassettes.title: SNAKE
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: The classic, on a 40 x 25 text screen. Eat, grow, don't bite yourself.
cassettes.controls:
W A S D: steer, hold two to turn twice
UP LEFT DOWN RIGHT: or steer
SPACE: start

cassettes.title: STACK
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: A falling-block puzzle. Trominoes, full rows clear, and every eighth piece is a bomb.
cassettes.controls:
A D: move
W: rotate
S: soft drop
LEFT RIGHT UP DOWN: the same
SPACE: hard drop, start

cassettes.title: SUN
cassettes.author: United Northern Computers
cassettes.about: A house, a sun, a horizon: twenty lines of UNC BASIC on the bitmap. Type LIST to read them.
cassettes.instructions: It draws itself. Then the machine is yours: type LIST to read the program, and change a line.
